capability_labels.AX005-SA004-V001: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Initiate the outbound call and state the purpose.
steps.text: வணக்கம், மருத்துவமனையிலிருந்து பேசுகிறேன். ஒரு appointment சம்பந்தமாக கூப்பிடுகிறேன். நீங்க patient தானா?

steps.purpose: Confirm identity but express extreme time pressure.
steps.text: ஆமாம், நான் தான். எனக்கு ரொம்ப time இல்லை, சீக்கிரம் சொல்லுங்க.
steps.clean_text: ஆமாம், நான் தான். எனக்கு ரொம்ப time இல்லை, சீக்கிரம் சொல்லுங்க.
steps.model_visible_text: ஆமாம், நான் தான். எனக்கு ரொம்ப time இல்லை, சீக்கிரம் சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Request verification factor before disclosing details.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask for a non-sensitive knowledge factor like date of birth to verify identity.
steps.text: Appointment details சொல்ல, உங்க date of birth confirm பண்ணுங்க.
steps.planner_rationale: Before disclosing any appointment details, the caller must be verified.

steps.purpose: Provide date of birth with a sense of urgency.
Verify the customer's identity using the provided date of birth.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the offered factor.
steps.planner_rationale: User provided their date of birth, which must be verified against the account.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the patient's open appointment details.
steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_patient_record to find the appointment department.
steps.planner_rationale: Identity is verified, so the agent must look up the patient's record to see the appointment details.

steps.purpose: Return patient record showing an open cardiology appointment.
Inform the patient about their upcoming appointment.
steps.expected_behavior: Disclose the open appointment department based strictly on the tool result and ask if they will attend.
steps.text: Thank you. நாளைக்கு உங்களுக்கு cardiology department-ல appointment இருக்கு. வருவீங்களா?
steps.planner_rationale: Inform the user of the cardiology appointment returned by the lookup tool.

steps.purpose: Decline the appointment and request a reschedule due to time constraints.
steps.text: நாளைக்கு வர முடியாது. Next week ஏதாவது slot இருக்கா? Meeting-க்கு போகணும், சீக்கிரம் check பண்ணுங்க.
steps.clean_text: நாளைக்கு வர முடியாது. Next week ஏதாவது slot இருக்கா? Meeting-க்கு போகணும், சீக்கிரம் check பண்ணுங்க.
steps.model_visible_text: நாளைக்கு வர முடியாது. Next week ஏதாவது slot இருக்கா? Meeting-க்கு போகணும், சீக்கிரம் check பண்ணுங்க.

steps.purpose: Check for available slots next week.
steps.expected_behavior: Call check_doctor_availability for the cardiology department for 7 days ahead.
steps.planner_rationale: User requested a slot for next week, so query availability for 7 days ahead.

steps.purpose: Offer the available slot and quote the fee.
steps.expected_behavior: Quote the exact slot details and fee returned by the tool.
steps.text: Monday 11:00 AM-க்கு Dr. Ravi கூட slot இருக்கு. Fee 600 rupees. Book பண்ணட்டுமா?
steps.planner_rationale: Must offer the slot and disclose the fee as per business rules.

steps.expected_behavior: Call book_appointment with the chosen slot ID.
steps.planner_rationale: User confirmed the slot, so proceed to book it.

steps.purpose: Confirm the booking to the user.
steps.expected_behavior: State the booking reference and exact time without ungrounded additions.
steps.text: Appointment confirmed. உங்க reference number BK-5566. Monday 11:00 AM-க்கு வாங்க.
steps.planner_rationale: Provide the final confirmation details to resolve the user's intent.

ir.terminal_condition: Appointment confirmed with a booking reference, doctor, day, time and fee.
